title: Three Noble Truths
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk's main teaching is that traditional Buddhist teachings on suffering can be limiting if they're presented as a list of truths to be memorized or understood intellectually. Instead, Nomon Tim Burnett suggests reframing these teachings as practical verbs or actions that help us engage with our lives more honestly and realistically, such as deep knowing and examination. This approach emphasizes the importance of direct experience and inner wisdom in understanding and transforming suffering, rather than just relying on external knowledge or formulas.
